issue_context.title: Scheduler Code Deep Cleanup: Scheduler, genericScheduler, and SchedulerAlgorithm
issue_context.body:
#### What would you like to be added:
Refactor the names of `Scheduler`, `SchedulerAlgorithm`, and `genericScheduler` to something like: 
`Scheduler`, `SchedulerAlgorithm`, and`SchedulerAlgorithmImpl`

#### Why is this needed:
I was reading the scheduler framework code and found out very confusing when reading the `type Scheduler struct` and `type genericScheduler struct` ([link](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8edda782f30a377afd031d5d7f4d62551785c441/pkg/scheduler/core/generic_scheduler.go#L79)). The name `genericXXXX` sounds very generic at least to myself... and no comments were there. 

In reality, the `genericScheduler` is just an implementation of the `SchedulerAlgorithm` interface above which will act as the algorithm component in the scheduler object. 

Another note is there was a TODO to rename the `SchedulerAlgorithm struct` before. ([Link](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8edda782f30a377afd031d5d7f4d62551785c441/pkg/scheduler/core/generic_scheduler.go#L60))

So, I suggest for the better organization of the scheduler code, some code refactorings of names of `Scheduler`, `SchedulerAlgorithm`, and `genericScheduler` is quite necessary.

what @ahg-g and I have discussed before is entirely getting rid of `SchedulerAlgorithm` and `genericScheduler`. IIRC, autoscaler used to use the `genericScheduler` to reuse scheduler code, but now it uses a `schedulerFramework`. So, with the existence of the scheduler framework, there is no need of 3 layers. Then, we should be merging whatever is in `genericScheduler` into the framework or `Scheduler`.

If you can find a way to do this in incremental PRs, I'm all in favor of that.

Renaming might help understanding the codebase, but it doesn't moving away from this structure.

Correct, we want to get rid of ScheduleAlgorithm and also refactor the code such that core/generic_scheduler.go and scheduler.go are merged and move whatever make sense to framework. Lots of code already moved out such as binding and preemption.

Looking at both those files, I don't think there is much we can move to the framework, so I think the next step is to work on merging them.

It makes sense to eliminate `ScheduleAlgorithm`. Additionally, we can use this chance to do a deep cleanup of `Scheduler`. For example, function `NextPod()` is basically equivalent to the embedded SchedulingQueue's Pop(), and hence not quite needed to be part of `Scheduler`.
Great! thanks, guys and I will start this mission with some incremental PRs.
Please send a plan before start sending PRs; it could be as simple as a checkbox task list in this issue of what you are planing to change/move.

### [WIP] I am planning to do this job architecturally in the following 6 phases (PRs). 

| ID      | Status      | Description | Comments     |  Related PR
| :---:  | :---:           |    :---            |          :---        | :---              |
| 1        |     ✅   |  Unroll ScheduleAlgorithm#Extenders()   |   Merged   | #102558
| 2        |    ❌   |  Unroll ScheduleAlgorithm#numFeasibleNodesToFind()   |   Abandoned |  #102936
| 2        |    ✅    |  Merge package `/scheduler/core` to `/scheduler`   |  Merged   |  #103475
| 3        |     🗓   |  Move code from func findNodesThatFitPod()  to scheduler.go   |  TBD     | 
| 4        |      🗓    |  Move code from func prioritizeNodes()  to scheduler.go   |  TBD    | 
| 5        |      🗓    |  Move code from func selectHost()  to scheduler.go and remaining everything in generic_scheduler.go  |  TBD   |
| 6        |      🗓    | More cleanups in scheduler.go        |  TBD     |
Perhaps you can split 2 in more than one PR

I'd suggest tweaking the plan a bit:

1. Unroll ScheduleAlgorithm#Extenders() to Scheduler.go ([1.diff](https://gist.github.com/Huang-Wei/53fafb11d2da1a65eb606e44061f6816) for your reference)
    - in scheduer.go, just specify an `Extenders` slice (instead of function `Extenders()`)
    - [temporary] add `[]framework.Extender` to ScheduleAlgorithm#Schedule()
    - so we can make some functions (e.g., g.findNodesThatPassExtenders, g.prioritizeNodes) stateless by adding extenders slice into the function signature, and you can keep stateful function as-is and refactor later
2. Unroll ScheduleAlgorithm#Schedule() to Scheduler.go (you may split this into a couple of PRs if needed)
